sources.locator: §5.3 Recurrence and Transience, printed pp.281–286 (PDF pp.289–294), especially Example 5.3.9, Theorem 5.3.10 with its finite-interval argument, and Theorem 5.3.11 with the escape-probability formula (printed pp.285–286/PDF pp.292–293); the local birth–death proof supplies the finite-interval exit bound explicitly. §5.4 opening through Theorem 5.4.4, printed pp.287–290 (PDF pp.295–298), especially Example 5.4.2 and the complete d=3 multinomial/Stirling return bound and d>3 three-coordinate skeleton. The local d≥3 estimate generalizes the d=3 coefficient bound directly and applies the earlier statewise Green-series criterion.

Durrett is cited at the printed pagination of the accessed fifth-edition PDF; the design’s pp.285–311 does not match its §5.3 opening, which is printed p.281 here. Roch Theorem 24.7 contains an equality at the nonexit limit that need not hold; the local scaffold uses only the valid Fatou domination inequality.
